subject.title: fix(mattermost): bound websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should Mattermost adopt a fixed 30-second WebSocket upgrade timeout, matching the existing bounded-connection pattern, despite potentially rejecting exceptionally slow proxy handshakes?
rationale: Source and proof establish that a deadline fixes the indefinite wait, but choosing the permanent hard cutoff determines the channel’s availability behavior under unusually slow upgrades.

options.title: Accept 30 seconds
options.body: Land the fixed plugin-local timeout as a bounded reliability default with no new configuration surface.

options.title: Revise the cutoff
options.body: Choose another fixed duration only if supported Mattermost deployment evidence demonstrates legitimate handshakes beyond 30 seconds.

recommendation.title: Accept 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Land the fixed plugin-local timeout as a bounded reliability default with no new configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged reconnect loop they introduced is the behavior whose failure boundary changes here.
